reason: The query explicitly specifies thermal aging as the intervention and asks for a ductile-brittle-ductile outcome, so those broad elements are strongly implied. It points toward an aging-temperature window, chemical ordering as a structural mediator, and an ordering-related ductility mechanism, but it does not determine the numerical temperature limits, L12/B2 details, phase-boundary morphology, or slip mechanism. It gives no basis for selecting AlCoCrFeNi2.1 in the as-cast FCC+B2 state or the conventional temper-embrittlement baseline. Many alloy systems, aging schedules, mechanisms, boundaries, and falsification experiments would reasonably satisfy the query.
